q: give me a net profit breakdown, waterfall for September 2026
answer:
Net profit was a loss of ₹-172,227 for September 2026 (order-date P&L). The business had positive contribution margin (₹1,021,095) but large P&L ad spend and sales deductions turned that into a loss.

- What moved the number (largest impacts, Sep 1–30, 2026, P&L order-date):
  - Ad spend: −₹1,193,322 — the single biggest negative line that turned contribution into a loss.
  - Contribution margin (net sales − net COGS): +₹1,021,095 (net sales ₹1,697,336; net COGS ₹676,241). Contribution margin alone would have left the business profitable.
  - Sales deductions: returns ₹371,999, discounts ₹110,359 and cancels ₹73,845 together reduced gross sales (₹2,253,539) down to net sales (₹1,697,336).
  - Operating & product costs inside net COGS: product cost ₹553,170 and operating cost ₹123,071 (shipping ₹76,743, packaging ₹18,237, gateway fees ₹12,919, RTO ₹15,171).

Worth checking: campaign/channel-level ad efficiency and the drivers of high return revenue (which erodes net sales).

Period: 2026-09-01..2026-09-30 · Currency: INR · Data as of 2026-10-14
